https://mastodon.social/@jordan@mastodon.text: I restored a "Double Dragon" (1987) arcade cabinet about 20 years ago. There's a glitch where if you're able to get the box from Mission 2 into Mission 3, it changes colors from tan to purple because of a color palette change. My family and I have been seeing how far we can get the box. It's hard because for some reason the enemies go after it like it's filled with money! We've resorted to one player carrying the box, and the other guarding him. #arcade #doubledragon #retrogaming #videogames
